faq.q: What is a before and after video?
faq.a: It is a short clip that shows a starting state, one practical action and the fixed state. You make it from one product photo and use it as a product demonstration ad.

faq.q: How do I make one from a product photo?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo and describe the starting state, action and result in one sentence. The generated clip keeps the same item and camera in view.

faq.q: How is this different from a traditional video shoot?
faq.a: A shoot needs the item staged twice, a camera setup and often a crew. Here both states are directed from the same photo in minutes, without booking another setup.

faq.q: Who should use before and after videos?
faq.a: Sellers whose product fixes something visible: a tote stain, dust on a shelf, tangled cords or a stuck zipper. Ecommerce brands and ad teams use them on product pages and paid campaigns.

faq.q: What video styles work for a before and after?
faq.a: Keep it simple: a fixed camera, a practical action and both states easy to compare. A cleaning demo, organizer reset or repair moment reads naturally in a feed.
The clip shows a change to an item or the space around it, not a health, skin or body result. A cleaned shoe, routed cable or dust-free shelf should match what your product really does.

faq.q: Which formats and platforms are supported?
faq.a: Download a 9:16 vertical clip for TikTok Ads and Instagram Reels, or a 1:1 square for a product page. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and downloads have no watermark.

faq.q: Can I add Before and After labels?
faq.a: Yes. Add them in your own editor after download, so labels for a stain, cord reset or shelf cleanup stay crisp and correctly spelled.
